issues.reason: Every Name in the instruction set attaches to an individual and Name is the individual-binding channel for queries, so a Name-bearing `pacificat` sitting in GroupOf's kind slot breaks the individual-vs-class discipline, and the string "PacifiCat" additionally violates the surface-form rule for string literals (the text reads "PacifiCats", so a query built from the text would not bind).

gaps_confirmed: a pluralized proper name denoting a class or series of vessels ("the PacifiCats") — the naming rules give a proper noun one symbol plus exactly one Name, and the definite-plural rule wants (GroupOf <group> <kind>), but nothing says how one name symbol can serve as the members' kind or what the Name string should be
new_gaps: a proper name functioning as a KIND (product line, vessel class) has no licensed carrier for its surface string at all — Name binds individuals — so dropping the atom leaves the surface form recorded only in the symbol
repair_summary: Removed (Name pacificat "PacifiCat"): the symbol is used as the members' kind in GroupOf, and no licensed relation records the surface string of a proper name in class position, so the ill-typed atom is dropped rather than replaced by an invention.
notes: The rest stands: distributive replication of the coordinated by-phrase into two design events sharing one Patient, passive by-phrase to Agent, the entity-attached (From …) origin and surface-faithful (Of …) oblique, and Patient for the designed vessels.
